name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport PR began unconventionally, with a degree in journalism and a passion for Formula 1. After years covering local racing events for a Buenos Aires newspaper, he transitioned into a communications role with a small touring car team. His knack for crafting compelling narratives and navigating complex media landscapes quickly became apparent. Ricardo believes in a data-driven approach to PR, meticulously tracking media mentions and engagement metrics to optimize outreach strategies. His meticulousness and commitment to authenticity set him apart, fostering trust with both the press and the public.

Having spent the last few years honing his skills, Ricardo joined CLRT by Almeras to take on a new challenge. He is excited to elevate the team's media profile and build strong relationships with their fans. His ability to remain calm under pressure and find creative solutions to communication crises makes him a valuable asset. He strives to present the team in the best possible light while staying true to the values of integrity and transparency.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a sturdy build and a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with story ideas.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk at all times.
Frequently quotes famous journalists and media figures.
